responsibility: This header declares GCC's simple concrete implementation of the `diagnostic_path` API. It defines `simple_diagnostic_event`, `simple_diagnostic_thread`, and `simple_diagnostic_path`, which store events in vectors with source locations, function logical locations, stack depths, formatted descriptions, thread IDs, and event-connectivity metadata, and it exposes helpers to append events/threads and disable event localization. It is the main eager in-memory path representation for production diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Declares the simple_diagnostic_event, simple_diagnostic_thread, and simple_diagnostic_path classes and their API, while the same-stem .cc file supplies the operational method definitions and selftests.
